reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Code verification confirms validation bypass in sync path. File outputs/01e_PARTIAL_W2B3_1771748669.json line 263 requires 'kzg_commitments must not be empty in a valid data column sidecar' with assertion 'forall sidecar: accepted(sidecar) => len(sidecar.kzg_commitments) > 0'. Gossip path (gossip_validation.nim:596) calls verify_data_column_sidecar() which checks empty at peerdas_helpers.nim:359 ('Data column contains zero blob'). Sync path (request_manager.nim:190 in checkColumnResponse) only calls verify_data_column_sidecar_inclusion_proof(), which validates Merkle proof but not length. Empty list has valid hash_tree_root, passes Merkle check, gets stored in dataColumnQuarantine (line 437). This violates the spec requirement that accepted sidecars must have non-empty kzg_commitments. Severity calibrated per BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json: single-client sync path validation bypass affecting data integrity. Impact threshold Medium (>5% network) appropriate as this affects one client implementation's sync reliability, not consensus-breaking but enables junk data storage and potential propagation.
